metadata.description: Ruvos Team Marketplace for Cursor / Grok Bot plugins.

plugins.name: ruvos-google-chat
plugins.description: Search spaces, resolve people, open DMs, read and send Google Chat via Ruvos OAuth middle-layer MCP (DCR).

plugins.name: ruvos-google-docs
plugins.description: Create and edit Google Docs in place via Docs API batchUpdate (headings, lists, tables, page breaks, text color and highlight, headers, footers, inline images via drive.file). A native table of contents is Insert → Table of contents in the Doc UI. A horizontal rule is Insert → Horizontal line in the Doc UI. Ruvos OAuth DCR. Not Word, not HTML, not a markdown upload.
